_about: Painted rough requests for #22 (Spark tower), made by the Art roughs workflow on Cloudflare Workers AI. ROUGH, not shipped. © 2026 justaskjoe. All rights reserved.
style: 2D storybook game asset, hand-painted fantasy cottage style: ink linework over painterly flat color, teal slate roofs, warm timber, cream plaster, mossy greens, dusty-rose sky. Single asset centered on a plain cream background, three-quarter top-down view, readable at small size. Original design, not resembling any existing franchise. No text.

items.subject: A cozy fantasy lightning tower: a round stone footing, a cream plaster drum with timber framing and one glowing blue window, an open belfry of four timber posts holding a glowing blue spark orb, and a tall teal slate cone roof with a lightning rod. Strong lit and shaded sides so it looks solid and three-dimensional.

Two upgraded versions of the same cozy round lightning tower side by side: on the left a taller one with forked lightning rods and crackling blue arcs and a small rust-red pennant; on the right a wider one with gold bands around the drum and a bigger glowing blue orb ringed with gold.

A cozy fantasy electricity cottage-tower: a small timber-framed cottage with a teal slate gable roof and glowing blue windows, and a tall stone chimney wrapped in timber coil rings topped by a crackling blue spark orb. Box shape with two visible walls, lit and shaded, so it looks solid and three-dimensional.

Two upgraded versions of the same electricity cottage side by side: on the left a second small coil on the gable with a blue lightning arc jumping to the chimney coil and a rust-red pennant; on the right a thicker chimney coil with gold bands and a larger glowing blue core.

A fantasy lightning conductor: two leaning carved stone pillars with teal slate pyramid caps standing on a square timber deck, with a floating faceted blue spark crystal between them and small blue lightning arcs jumping from the crystal to each pillar. Strong faceted planes, lit and shaded, so it looks solid and three-dimensional.

Two upgraded versions of the same stone lightning conductor side by side: on the left three pillars with an arc over the top and a rust-red pennant; on the right a much bigger blue crystal circled by two gold rings.
